title: The Robot Who Is Sad and Katara
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hello Katara.

- What brings you here, robot?

- I heard you know how to heal.

- It’s true.

- Cure my sadness.

- I can heal flesh wounds, but not mental ones. In addition…

Katara was clearly lost in thought. The robot could not wait and asked:

- What?

- You are a robot.

- …who is sad.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and Reptiloids
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hi, Reptiloids.

- Are you afraid of me?

- I’m not.

- But I’m Reptiloids! Everyone is afraid of me!

- It is very sad.

Reptiloids was very sad about something. His serpentine eyes were full of longing. It looked like he was about to cry… If he could.

- It’s very sad for sure, robot.

- I know. But what do you mean?

- Everyone expects me to take over the world. But I can’t, I have no idea how to do that! And I don’t even want that!

- What do you want then?

- Dance…

- I’m sad.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and Steam
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hello Steam.

- Do you want to buy something, robot?

- I’m sad.

- But I have good discounts.

- I’m still sad.

Steam left. After a while, he returned and said to the robot:

- It’s a free weekend, robot.

- I’m still sad.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and the Olympic Flame
text:
- Hi, robot.

The robot looked upon the Olympic Flame and left. Having come to the Void, he said:

- I’m sad, but I’m not going to talk to the Olympic Flame.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and My Thesis Project
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hello, My Thesis Project.

- Do you have a creator, a robot?

- I do.

My Thesis Project sighed. There was sadness in him. And he said to the robot:

- I don’t have one.

- It is very sad.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and the Void
The Robot Who Is Sad and the Creator.
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hello Creator.

- How do you feel?

- I’m sad.

- As it should be.

The robot left. For a long time he wandered around the world. Not being able to find the answer, he decided to return to the Creator.

- Hi, robot.

- Hello Creator.

- Are you still sad?

- Yes, I’m still sad.

- It will remain so forever.

- But why?

- Because you are The Robot Who Is Sad. Remember this.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and The Robot Who Is Cheerful
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hi, robot.

- How was your day?

- I was sad.

- It is very cheerful.

For a while, the robots were standing opposite to each other in complete silence.

- And how was your day?

- I was cheerful.

- It is very sad.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and Vikings
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hello Vikings.

- How are you feeling?

- I’m sad.

- Do not despair. Do you want to do some robbing and killing together?

- Fine.

For a while the robot robbed caravans, killed women and raped men. The Vikings supported his activities approvingly. After bloody fun and a drunken feast, the robot and the Vikings met again.

- Hi, robot.

- Hello Vikings.

- Well, robot, have you got your fill of robbing and killing?

- I guess so.

- How does it feel?

- I’m sad.

title: The Robot Who Is Sad and President
text:
- Hi, robot.

- Hi, President.

- How do you feel, robot?

- I’m sad.

- Vote for me, and I promise that your mood will improve.

The robot left. When the time came, he voted for the President. They met again.

- Hi, robot.

- Hi, President.

- Did you vote for me?

- Yes.

- Do you feel better?

- I’m still sad.
